remaining_scope_limits: Scope is production dependency closure of all locked instances of the 35 packages named by preserved bundled-license headers, excluding @types, dev dependencies, optional dependencies and peer-only packages.
This conservative source-lock inventory includes some build/server dependencies not proven to be present in client bundles; package presence in the lockfile does not prove inclusion.
This is not a byte-for-byte software bill of materials for every minified frontend chunk. Packages with no preserved header may require separate identification.
Original legal files and embedded legal headers are copied unchanged; application/theme code is not modified by this audit.

Some legacy packages omit standalone license files. Their explicit npm SPDX declarations, exact retained legal notices, npm author attributions and full standard-license reference text are distinguished from original license files. No missing copyright statement is invented.
